0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8, 0-4 on the road) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, winners of three straight), who sit second in the Northwest, one game back. Utah is on a seven-game losing streak and is 14th in the West, while Minnesota is 5th in the West. Missing for Utah are Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), both out, and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), who is day-to-day and a game-time decision; for Minnesota, Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery) are out, and Joan Beringer (fracture) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Jazz lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 147-111 loss in Minneapolis on March 18.
